answer: Each orchard site is one registered vertex hosting a fixed pest-trap lantern. The buyer pays once per site-hour for at least 10 Wh, verified in meter-signed site/hour/payee receipts. Conflicting signed payees for one slot permanently end that site's payments across all keys. Extra identities gain no slots; parallel farms and colluders must supply real sites and power. Compromised meters or duplicate site certification break the bound. This does not prove unique humans.
